facts.material: Styrofoam form covered ~75% (surface) by sisal and cattails (plaiting materials), plus twig slices, straw, banana leaf, plastic eyes/pine needles

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 4602 articles made directly to shape from plaiting materials; chapter 46 note 1 defines plaiting materials to include unspun natural textile fibers (sisal) and straw; ch. 46 note 2 has no applicable exclusion
GRI 3(b): composite, plaiting-material covering gives essential character (about 75% of surface)

rejected_alternatives.reason: wood articles; wood twig slices are minor part of surface
textile made-up article; sisal is plaiting material of chapter 46 not textile fabric
plastic figurine; plastic is only eyes and needles
decoration is not a festive article, no festive use stated

classification.rationale: Decorative owl mostly covered by plaiting materials is classified in heading 4602; N331116 placed a similar owl figure (grass, twig, sisal, foam) in 4602.19.8000.
